Authentication &amp; Identity Management</b><br><i>Identity and authentication management</i><br><b>1.1 Registration</b><br>• Create a new account.<br>• Enter full name.<br>• Enter email address.<br>• Enter password.<br>• Confirm password.<br>• Accept terms of use and privacy policy.<br>• Email verification.<br>• Prevent creating accounts with duplicate emails.<br>• Validate entered data.<br><b>1.2 Login</b><br>• Log in with email and password.<br>• Validate login credentials.<br>• User session management.<br>• Remember the user when selected.<br>• Log out.<br>• Log out from all devices.<br>• Show clear error messages when login fails.<br><b>1.3 Password Management</b><br>• Request password recovery.<br>• Send reset link.<br>• Validate link validity.<br>• Set a new password.<br>• Invalidate reset links after use.<br>• End old sessions when the password changes according to security policy.<br><b>1.4 User Profile</b><br>• View profile.<br>• Edit name.<br>• Edit profile picture.<br>• Edit personal bio.<br>• Edit contact information.<br>• Change password.<br>• Change language.<br>• Set time zone.<br>• View workspaces the user belongs to.<br>• View basic user activity.<br><b>1.5 Account Management</b><br>• Deactivate account.<br>• Request account deletion.<br>• Log out.<br>• Manage active sessions.<br>• View connected devices when supported." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="720" width="400" x="40" y="200" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="mDeQGMzjkuG4_2jXmyQS-3" parent="1" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacingLeft=10;spacingTop=6;spacingRight=8;fontSize=12;fillColor=#dae8fc;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;" value="<b>2. Security &amp; Privacy Functions</b><br><i>Security and privacy functions</i><br>• Identity verification.<br>• Permission verification.<br>• Session protection.<br>• Password protection.<br>• LiveKit token protection.<br>• Webhook verification.<br>• Resource ownership verification.<br>• File protection.<br>• Prevent access between workspaces.<br>• Protect API endpoints from abuse.<br>• Rate Limiting.<br>• Input validation.<br>• Protection against SQL Injection.<br>• Protection against XSS.<br>• Protection against CSRF where applicable to the authentication mechanism.<br>• Manage secrets in secure environment variables.<br>• Use HTTPS.<br>• Manage data retention policies.<br>• Delete user data according to organization policy.<br>• Request consent before recording and processing.<br>• Define access permissions for recordings and transcripts." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="400" width="400" x="1300" y="1092" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="mDeQGMzjkuG4_2jXmyQS-18" parent="1" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacingLeft=10;spacingTop=6;spacingRight=8;fontSize=12;fillColor=#e1d5e7;strokeColor=#9673a6;" value="<b>17. System &amp; Background Processing</b><br><i>Internal system functions</i><br><b>17.1 Background Jobs</b><br>• Create a processing task.<br>• Put it in a Queue.<br>• Select a suitable Worker.<br>• Execute the task.<br>• Update task status.<br>• Retry.<br>• Log the error.<br>• Prevent duplicate execution.<br>• Finish the task.<br>• Clean up temporary files.<br><b>17.2 Scheduled Tasks</b><br>• Send meeting reminders.<br>• Send task reminders.<br>• Clean up temporary files.<br>• Manage expired data according to policy.<br>• Execute scheduled operations.<br><b>17.3 System Monitoring</b><br>• Monitor API.<br>• Monitor Redis.<br>• Monitor PostgreSQL.<br>• Monitor MinIO.<br>• Monitor LiveKit.<br>• Monitor Workers.<br>• Log errors.<br>• Trace requests and operations.<br>• Measure response time.<br><b>17.4 Reliability</b><br>• Handle service failures.<br>• Retry.<br>• Handle network interruptions.<br>• Recover stalled tasks.<br>• Handle duplicate Webhooks.<br>• Protect operations from unintended duplication." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="590" width="400" x="1300" y="1508" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="mDeQGMzjkuG4_2jXmyQS-19" parent="1" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacingLeft=10;spacingTop=6;spacingRight=8;fontSize=12;fillColor=#e1d5e7;strokeColor=#9673a6;" value="<b>18. User Experience &amp; Interface</b><br><i>User experience functions</i><br>• Responsive interface.<br>• Support for desktop, tablet and phone.<br>• Sidebar navigation menu.<br>• Switch between workspaces.<br>• Organized project pages.<br>• Kanban interface.<br>• Chat interface.<br>• Meeting interface.<br>• Recordings interface.<br>• Meeting assistant interface.<br>• Loading states.<br>• Empty States.<br>• Error states.<br>• Success and failure messages.<br>• Confirmation of sensitive operations.<br>• Quick search.<br>• Basic shortcuts.<br>• Light and dark mode support.<br>• English and Arabic language support.<br>• RTL support for the Arabic interface when implemented.<br>• Accessibility considerations." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="400" width="400" x="1300" y="2114" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="mDeQGMzjkuG4_2jXmyQS-20" parent="1" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacingLeft=10;spacingTop=6;spacingRight=8;fontSize=12;fillColor=#f5f5f5;strokeColor=#666666;" value="<b>19. Advanced &amp; Future Functionalities</b><br><i>Future release functionalities</i><br><b>19.1 Collaborative Whiteboard</b><br>• Create a whiteboard.<br>• Drawing.<br>• Add shapes.<br>• Add text.<br>• Simultaneous collaboration.<br>• Save the whiteboard.<br>• Link the whiteboard to a project or meeting.<br><b>19.2 Advanced Calendar</b><br>• Personal calendar.<br>• Team calendar.<br>• Meeting scheduling.<br>• Recurring meetings.<br>• Conflict management.<br>• External calendar sync when needed.<br><b>19.3 Webinars &amp; Events</b><br>• Create a Webinar.<br>• Manage registration.<br>• Manage speakers.<br>• Manage attendance.<br>• Show the broadcast.<br>• Record the event.<br>• Attendance reports.<br><b>19.4 Advanced AI</b><br>• Speaker identification (Diarization).<br>• Semantic search in meetings.<br>• Ask questions about a past meeting.<br>• Compare multiple meetings.<br>• Detect recurring topics.<br>• Extract historical decisions.<br>• Summarize long meetings in stages.<br>• Multi-language support.<br>• Improve Arabic dialect processing.<br>• Suggest tasks based on project context.<br><b>19.5 Advanced Analytics</b><br>• Meeting statistics.<br>• Project statistics.<br>• Task completion indicators.<br>• Participation indicators.<br>• Platform usage indicators.<br>• Organization reports.<br><b>19.6 Mobile Applications</b><br>• Android app.<br>• iOS app.<br>• Push notifications.<br>• Meeting participation.<br>• Task management.<br>• View recordings and summaries." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="820" width="400" x="1300" y="2530" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="mDeQGMzjkuG4_2jXmyQS-21" parent="1" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacingLeft=10;spacingTop=6;spacingRight=8;fontSize=12;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;strokeWidth=2;" value="<b>20. MVP — Official First Release</b><br>These are the functionalities to focus on in the first release:<br><b>A. Identity &amp; Workspace</b><br>• Registration.<br>• Login / Logout.<br>• Password Reset.<br>• Email Verification.<br>• User Profile.<br>• Workspace Creation.<br>• Workspace Members.<br>• Invitations.<br>• Basic RBAC.<br><b>B. Collaboration</b><br>• Teams.<br>• Projects.<br>• Channels.<br>• Direct Messages.<br>• Real-Time Messaging.<br>• Basic Notifications.<br><b>C. Project Management</b><br>• Project Creation.<br>• Project Members.<br>• Task Creation.<br>• Task Assignment.<br>• Task Status.<br>• Kanban Board.<br>• Task Comments.<br><b>D. File Management</b><br>• Upload.<br>• Download.<br>• Delete.<br>• Basic Organization.<br>• Permissions.<br><b>E. Meetings</b><br>• Meeting Creation.<br>• Meeting Joining.<br>• LiveKit Integration.<br>• Audio / Video.<br>• Screen Sharing.<br>• Participant Management.<br>• Recording.<br>• Meeting History.<br><b>F. AI Meeting Assistant</b><br>• Recording Processing.<br>• Whisper Transcription.<br>• Transcript Storage.<br>• AI Summary.<br>• Decision Extraction.<br>• Action Item Extraction.<br>• Human Review.<br>• Task Creation from Approved Action Items.<br><b>G. System</b><br>• Redis.<br>• BullMQ.<br>• Workers.<br>• MinIO.<br>• PostgreSQL.<br>• Docker Compose.<br>• Basic Monitoring.<br>• Unit &amp; Integration Testing." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="980" width="400" x="40" y="3306" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="mDeQGMzjkuG4_2jXmyQS-22" parent="1" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacingLeft=10;spacingTop=6;spacingRight=8;fontSize=12;fillColor=#f8cecc;strokeColor=#b85450;" value="<b>21. Out of MVP Scope</b><br>The following functionalities are postponed to avoid project bloat:<br>• Advanced Whiteboard.<br>• Advanced Calendar.<br>• Webinars.<br>• Mobile Applications.<br>• Advanced Analytics.<br>• Semantic Search.<br>• Training a custom AI model.<br>• Many external integrations.<br>• Complex enterprise management system.<br>• Billing and subscriptions system." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="260" width="400" x="880" y="3306" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="mDeQGMzjkuG4_2jXmyQS-23" parent="1" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacingLeft=10;spacingTop=6;spacingRight=8;fontSize=12;fillColor=#fff2cc;strokeColor=#d6b656;strokeWidth=2;" value="<b>22. MVP Definition of Done</b><br>The first release is not considered complete merely because all the pages exist.<br>It must succeed in the following end-to-end scenario:<br>1. A user creates an account.<br>2. Creates a Workspace.<br>3. Invites other members.<br>4. Creates a Project.<br>5. Creates a Channel linked to the project.<br>6. Members communicate via messages.<br>7. The user creates a Task and assigns it.<br>8. Creates a meeting linked to the project.<br>9. Participants join the meeting.<br>10. Camera, microphone and screen sharing work.<br>11. The meeting is recorded.<br>12. The recording is saved in MinIO.<br>13. A Webhook is sent after recording completes.<br>14. A Worker starts processing the recording.<br>15. Whisper extracts the text.<br>16. The LLM creates the summary, decisions and suggested tasks.<br>17. The user reviews the results.<br>18. The user approves the correct tasks.<br>19. The tasks appear in the Kanban Board.<br>20. Members can track their execution.<br>If this scenario succeeds reliably, NexaMeet has achieved the core of its idea." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="460" width="400" x="1300" y="3366" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>

NexaMeet — Complete Functionalities Catalogue
Functional Requirements & System Capabilities
Product: NexaMeet
Category: University Collaboration & Intelligent Meeting Platform
Core Concept: Connect. Collaborate. Understand. Act.

div.div:
1. Authentication & Identity Management
Identity and authentication management
1.1 Registration
• Create a new account.
• Enter full name.
• Enter email address.
• Enter password.
• Confirm password.
• Accept terms of use and privacy policy.
• Email verification.
• Prevent creating accounts with duplicate emails.
• Validate entered data.
1.2 Login
• Log in with email and password.
• Validate login credentials.
• User session management.
• Remember the user when selected.
• Log out.
• Log out from all devices.
• Show clear error messages when login fails.
1.3 Password Management
• Request password recovery.
• Send reset link.
• Validate link validity.
• Set a new password.
• Invalidate reset links after use.
• End old sessions when the password changes according to security policy.
1.4 User Profile
• View profile.
• Edit name.
• Edit profile picture.
• Edit personal bio.
• Edit contact information.
• Change password.
• Change language.
• Set time zone.
• View workspaces the user belongs to.
• View basic user activity.
1.5 Account Management
• Deactivate account.
• Request account deletion.
• Log out.
• Manage active sessions.
• View connected devices when supported.

• Leave a workspace.
• Show current workspace data.
2.3 Workspace Settings
• Edit name and description.
• Edit logo.
• Set privacy settings.
• Manage invitations.
• Manage members.
• Set notification settings.
• Set file and recording policies.

2.4 Workspace Members

• Accept invitations.
• Decline invitations.
• Cancel sent invitations.
• Resend invitation.
• Change a member's role.
• Remove a member.
• View join date.
• View membership status.

6. Task Management — Kanban
Task management

• Create a task.

• Enter description.
• Set the project.
• Set the assignee.
• Set priority.
• Set due date.
• Add Labels.
• Attach files.
• Add a subtask checklist.
6.2 Task Status
• To Do.

6.3 Kanban Board

• View overdue tasks.

• Change the assignee.
• Change the deadline.
• Add a comment.
• View edit history.
• View linked files.

6.5 Subtasks & Dependencies
• Create subtasks.

6.6 Task Notifications
• Notify the user when a task is assigned to them.

• Notify when the due date is approaching.
• Notify when overdue.

div.div:
22. MVP Definition of Done
The first release is not considered complete merely because all the pages exist.
It must succeed in the following end-to-end scenario:
1. A user creates an account.
2. Creates a Workspace.
3. Invites other members.
4. Creates a Project.
5. Creates a Channel linked to the project.
6. Members communicate via messages.
7. The user creates a Task and assigns it.
8. Creates a meeting linked to the project.
9. Participants join the meeting.
10. Camera, microphone and screen sharing work.
11. The meeting is recorded.
12. The recording is saved in MinIO.
13. A Webhook is sent after recording completes.
14. A Worker starts processing the recording.
15. Whisper extracts the text.
16. The LLM creates the summary, decisions and suggested tasks.
17. The user reviews the results.
18. The user approves the correct tasks.
19. The tasks appear in the Kanban Board.
20. Members can track their execution.
If this scenario succeeds reliably, NexaMeet has achieved the core of its idea.
